Google TPU update: New OpenAI and Anthropic orders extend shipment visibility to 2029; v10 lineup overhauled (now Quillfish); MediaTek and Broadcom lead as the top suppliers to watch Key takeaways from my latest industry survey and research conclusions: 1. Order visibility and shipment plans: Strong new orders from OpenAI and Anthropic have extended Google TPU shipment visibility to 2029, ahead of Nvidia GPUs and other AI ASICs (mostly 4Q27–2Q28). (1) From 2028, v9 will become the mainstay of Google’s own compute buildout, so v8-series orders (8t / 8i or their design variants) can be viewed as coming from OpenAI and Anthropic. (2) Combined 2028–2029 demand: about 12M units for OpenAI (8t, designed by MediaTek) and about 14M for Anthropic (8i, designed by Broadcom), with both growing year over year. OpenAI buys outright, while Anthropic uses a mix of leasing and outright purchases. (3) Given supply chain constraints, more reasonable TPU shipment estimates for 2027–2029 are 8–9M, 14–15M, and 16–18M units, respectively. The market broadly expects AI capex to peak in 2028, yet this plan shows TPU shipments still growing in 2029, driven by direct orders from AI service leaders OpenAI and Anthropic. 2. v10 lineup and supply chain changes: v10 has changed from Icefish and Merope / Bladerunner to Quillfish, with mass production expected in 2029. MediaTek has won the design service order. (1) Icefish is now v11, with mass production expected in 2030 and the design service order also going to MediaTek. Merope has lower visibility: no supplier has been chosen, and it may be canceled. (2) MediaTek will be the sole supplier for v9 (Humufish & Triggerfish) and v10 (Quillfish), accounting for about 45–50%, 50–55%, and 55–60% of total TPU supply in 2027–2029, respectively. TPU’s contribution to its revenue and profit should rise each year. (3) From v9 onward, all new TPUs use Intel’s EMIB-T advanced packaging. Given limited initial production capacity, the v8 series should remain the bulk of TPU shipments through 2029. v8 is expected to be the main source of TPU profit growth for MediaTek and Broadcom over the next few years, thanks to significant accumulated learning-curve benefits and the fact that both handle procurement of key components and materials. 3. Market attention and supplier outlook: Recent events should raise and sustain market attention on Google TPU, with key design service providers MediaTek and Broadcom likely to be the supply chain’s top focus. (1) Uncertainty over Nvidia’s CEO succession helps Google in discussing post-2028 long-term plans with customers. OpenAI and Anthropic are both key TPU customers, so their IPOs should also raise and sustain attention on TPU, and MediaTek and Broadcom are the suppliers the market most readily associates with it. (2) MediaTek is clearly the biggest TPU winner of the next few years. Its position as sole design supplier from v9 onward, together with a supply share that rises each year alongside TPU shipments, will expand its TPU revenue. The high-margin 8t series, with shipment visibility through 2029, is a key profit source. (3) Because Broadcom leads the 8i design, its gross margin is even higher than the 8t’s, supporting Broadcom’s profit growth. Note, however, that Broadcom’s focus over the next few years will be non-TPU XPU and AI networking chip orders, with non-TPU revenue expected to surpass TPU revenue as early as 2027.

Google TPU 重點更新：OpenAI 與 Anthropic 新訂單推升出貨能見度至 2029 年、v10 產品線大幅調整 (改為 Quillfish)、聯發科與 Broadcom 為供應商中之領先關注焦點 我最新的產業調查與研究結論： 1. 訂單能見度與出貨規劃： 受惠於 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 強勁新訂單，Google TPU 出貨能見度已達 2029 年，優於 Nvidia GPU 與其他 AI ASIC（多數為 4Q27–2Q28）。 (1) 自 2028 年起，v9 將成 Google 自建算力的主力方案，v8 系列（8t／8i 或其設計變種）訂單可視為來自 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。 (2) 2028–2029 年合計需求數量：OpenAI 約 12M（聯發科設計的 8t），Anthropic 約 14M（Broadcom 設計的 8i），兩者需求均呈逐年成長趨勢。OpenAI 採買斷，Anthropic 則是租賃與買斷都有。 (3) 考量供應鏈限制，2027–2029 年較合理的 TPU 出貨估算分別為 8–9M、14–15M、16–18M。市場普遍預期 AI 資本支出於 2028 年見頂，但此規劃顯示 TPU 在 2029 年仍具出貨成長動能，關鍵在於 AI 服務龍頭 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的直接訂單。 2. v10 產品線與供應鏈調整： v10 由原先的 Icefish 與 Merope／Bladerunner 改為 Quillfish，預計 2029 年量產，設計服務訂單由聯發科取得。 (1) Icefish 改為 v11，預計 2030 年量產，設計服務訂單同由聯發科取得。Merope 能見度較低，供應商未定，也可能取消。 (2) 聯發科將是 v9（Humufish & Triggerfish）與 v10（Quillfish）的獨家供應商，2027–2029 年占整體 TPU 供應比重分別約 45–50%、50–55%、55–60%。TPU 對其營收與利潤的貢獻預計逐年增加。 (3) 自 v9 起新款 TPU 均採 Intel EMIB-T 先進封裝。考量初期量產能力，預期至 2029 年仍以 v8 系列為 TPU 出貨主力。v8 預期將是聯發科與 Broadcom 未來數年的 TPU 事業獲利成長的主要來源，因長期累積的學習曲線效益明顯，加上雙方負責關鍵零組件與材料採購。 3/ 市場關注度與供應商展望： 近期事件有助提升並維持 Google TPU 的市場關注度，關鍵設計服務商聯發科與 Broadcom 可望成為供應鏈首要焦點。 (1) Nvidia CEO 接班的不確定性，有利 Google 與客戶洽談 2028 年後的長期規劃。OpenAI 與 Anthropic 均為 TPU 關鍵客戶，其 IPO 也有助提升並維持 TPU 關注度，而聯發科與 Broadcom 是市場最容易聯想到的供應商。 (2) 聯發科無疑是未來數年 TPU 的最大贏家，身為 v9 後的獨家設計供應商，加上供應比重與 TPU 出貨成長同時逐年提升，均有利 TPU 事業營收規模擴大。高毛利率的 8t 系列出貨能見度達 2029 年，為關鍵利潤來源。 (3) 因 Broadcom 主導 8i 設計，故毛利率更高於 8t，有利該公司利潤成長。不過，需注意的是，Broadcom 未來數年的營運重點為非 TPU 的 XPU 與 AI 網路晶片訂單，預計最快 2027 年，非 TPU 營收將超越 TPU。
